issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires Farm.animals to be a List initialized as an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor, but the reference solution implements animals as a Set (HashSet). This is a structural mismatch: the collection type (List vs Set) changes semantics (ordering, duplicates) and the concrete implementation (ArrayList vs HashSet) differs from the instructions. Students following the problem text would implement a List/ArrayList, while the solution uses Set/HashSet, creating confusion and making automated checks or manual comparisons inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution follow the specification: change the Farm.animals field to a List<Animal> and initialize it with an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor (and update getter/setter types accordingly). Alternatively, if using a Set is intentional, update the problem statement to specify a Set/HashSet and remove the ArrayList requirement so requirements and solution match.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML explicitly require the Farm to use a List implemented with an ArrayList for the animals aggregation, but the solution implements the animals collection as a Set (HashSet). This divergence in the collection type/name (List/ArrayList vs Set/HashSet) can confuse students: the instructions and UML mention List/ArrayList and expect initialization of an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, while the solution uses a differently named collection type and implementation. Students mapping the specification to the implementation may be unsure which collection type is intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the problem statement and UML. Either update the solution to use List<Animal> and initialize an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor (private List<Animal> animals; this.animals = new ArrayList<>();), or adjust the problem statement/UML to explicitly accept/set a Set/HashSet and explain the reason for using a set. Prefer updating the solution to List/ArrayList to match the given instructions and UML.
